info.title: Event Booking App
info.description: This is the Event Booking App - API Documentation generated using Swagger

post.summary: Book an event for an attendee
post.description: This API allows an attendee to book an event by providing details such as name, email, and event ID.

email.description: The email address of the attendee.

event_id.description: The ID of the event being booked.

phone.description: The phone number of the attendee (optional).

400.description: Bad request - validation error or event already booked

message.example: Event ABC already booked by john.doe@example.com on 2025-04-22.

422.description: Validation error - required fields missing or invalid

post.description: This API allows a user to get their booked events by providing their email and optionally a page number for pagination.

requestBody.description: The user's email and page number for pagination

email.description: The email address of the user.

404.description: No events found for the user

message.example: No events found for user with email: john.doe@example.com.

422.description: Validation error - invalid email or page number

items.example: The page number must be at least 1.

post.description: Fetches a paginated list of users with role (attendees). Accepts page_number in the request body.
Adds a new user with the role of an attendee.

requestBody.description: User data to be added as an attendee

items.example: The email has already been taken.

put.description: Updates an existing attendee user's account by passing raw JSON and the user ID in the request body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID of the attendee to update

items.example: The email has already been taken.

post.summary: List attendees of a specific event with pagination
post.description: Fetches a paginated list of attendees for a specific event by event ID. The page number is passed in the request body.

post.summary: Add an attendee to a specific event
post.description: Adds an attendee to a specific event by providing their email. The attendee will be added if they are not already registered for the event.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the event to which the attendee is being added

requestBody.description: User data (email) to be added to the event as an attendee

message.example: Attendee added to the event successfully

400.description: Bad Request (Invalid input, user already added, etc.)

message.example: User is already an attendee of this event

post.summary: Remove an attendee from a specific event
post.description: Removes an attendee from a specific event using the provided email. The user must be a registered attendee of the event.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the event from which the attendee is being removed

requestBody.description: User data (email) to be removed from the event

message.example: Attendee removed from the event successfully

400.description: User is not an attendee of this event

message.example: User is not an attendee of this event
You have provided wrong credentials (or) your account does not exits!

post.summary: List all events with pagination and state filter
post.description: Get a list of all events with pagination and event state filtering support.

requestBody.description: Pagination and event state filter data

location_country.description: The location to filter events by country

get.summary: View event details along with total bookings
get.description: Get the details of a specific event, including the event name, description, date, location, available seats, and total bookings.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the event to fetch

post.description: Create a new event by passing raw JSON and Bearer token in the header.
